create_InputDocument: create an InputDocument from a file path or BytesIO stream with format and backend configuration
build_ConversionResult: build a ConversionResult containing document status, pages, timings, confidence report, and the converted DoclingDocument
run_guess_format: run format guessing on a Path or DocumentStream by detecting mime type from extension, content, or file signature
test_detect_html_xhtml: test HTML, XHTML, or XML detection from raw bytes by inspecting doctype declarations and markup patterns
review_DocumentConversionInput_docs: review the DocumentConversionInput iterator that yields InputDocuments with format-matched backends from a path or stream collection
